name: UniFi Network Health
description: Gateway health, throughput, existing speed-test metrics and eight clients per page with collapsed filtering. No speed test is triggered. Client names, IPs and MACs are intentionally displayed. The separate third-party public-IP lookup is excluded.

site.label: UniFi site
site.description: Site ID from the controller URL; usually 'default'.

downPlan.label: Plan download (Mbps)
downPlan.description: Scales the live bar and colors speed-test results (green ≥ 90%, yellow ≥ 70%).

showAddresses.label: Show client IP and MAC
showAddresses.description: Turn off on boards other people can see.

template:

[]).filter(s => s.subsystem === "wan")?.[0]?.status === "ok" ? "green" : "red"}>{(data.health?.data ?? []).filter(s => s.subsystem === "wan")?.[0]?.status ?? "unknown"}</Badge><RefreshButton requestId="health" /></Group><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{(data.health?.data ?? []).filter(s => s.subsystem === "wan")?.[0]?.isp_name ??
